text: じかんが　たつのを　わすれるわ！

structure.jp: じかんが　たつのを

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.span: じかんが　たつのを
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing, so it can be what you forget. じかんが　たつのを = 'that time is passing'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way to add feeling to what you say. わすれるわ = 'I forget, you know!'.
